Package aor.proj3t.util.converterutils

Class AbstractConverter<E,D,ID>

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.util.converterutils.AbstractConverter<E,D,ID>
Type Parameters:
D - The DTO type (data transfer object)
ID - The type of the entity's ID field
All Implemented Interfaces:
Converter<E,D>
Direct Known Subclasses:
EvaluationConverter, EvaluationCycleConverter, MessageConverter, NotificationConverter, PendingRegistrationConverter, ResetPasswordConverter, SessionConverter, SettingsConverter, TrainingAreaConverter, TrainingConverter, TrainingParticipationConverter, UserConverter, WorkplaceConverter
public abstract class AbstractConverter<E,D,ID> extends Object implements Converter<E,D>
Abstract base class for entity-DTO converters that implements common functionality. This class provides a template implementation of the Converter interface, implementing the conversion algorithms while allowing subclasses to define specific mapping logic through abstract methods. It introduces the Template Method pattern to standardize the overall conversion process while allowing customization of specific steps. Key features:
  • Implements the basic conversion algorithms for both individual objects and collections
  • Handles null values safely
  • Manages entity lookup, creation, and relationship handling
  • Provides utility methods for common operations like safe entity lookup
* @param The entity type (domain model object)
